r: Jhaeld sent me to ask you about the people that have gone missing.
I don't think so, I've never been here before.
Yes, I was just here, remember?

duaina_1.m:
The dreams and the visions. It is you! The child that challenges the beast.
[Duaina gives you a terrified look]
r: So you have seen me in your visions?

duaina_2.m: The sleeping beast. No, no. The blinding light. Oh, why have you come here? Have you come for me?

r: I'm not here to get you, if that's what you are afraid of.

duaina_4.m: I can see it in you. You have the gift. The gift that will destroy the beast. My visions were true.
r: Maybe you are confusing me with my brother Andor?

duaina_5.m: A brother? Yes, that must be what I saw in my visions. It is all becoming clearer.

duaina_6.m: The black hand sweeps over the land. The beast that hunts. Nooo! Leave this place!
r: I'm not here to hurt you!

duaina_7.m: The child and the brother. The unsuspecting people. The beast casts its shadow.

duaina_8.m: [Duaina stares at you in silence while holding her hand over her mouth]
r: What else have you seen in your visions?

duaina_s_0.m: I have seen you in my visions.

duaina_s_1a.m: Slaying the beast beneath the prison of Flagstone.

duaina_s_2a.m: Cooperating with the thieves in Fallhaven.

duaina_s_2b.m: Working against the thieves in Fallhaven.

duaina_s_3a.m: Something about a dagger returned to an ancestor in a tomb.

duaina_s_3b.m: Something about stealing a dagger in a dark tomb.

flagstone.5: Yolgen asked me to have a look at what is wrong with Flagstone prison.
flagstone.10: I met a guard from Stoutford on sentry duty outside a fortress called Flagstone. He told me that Flagstone used to serve as a prison for house Gorland of Stoutford, but it is now abandoned. Recently, undead have started pouring out of Flagstone. I should investigate the source of the undead monsters. The guard tells me to return to him if I need help.
flagstone.20: I found a dug out tunnel beneath Flagstone, that seems to lead to a larger cave. The cave is guarded by a demon that I am not even able to approach. Maybe the guard outside Flagstone knows more?
flagstone.30: The guard suggested that the former warden may have something to do with this, and I should go and look for him. If I find him I should return to the guard with any important news.
flagstone.31: I found the former warden of Flagstone on the upper level. Among his remains I found a necklace with some inscriptions. I should return to the guard now.
flagstone.40: I have learned the words required to approach the demon beneath Flagstone. 'Daylight Shadow'. It seems like the warden has something to do with the monster invasion.
flagstone.50: Deep beneath Flagstone, I found a powerful winged demon. It seems like the warden kept on running the prison and experimented with necromancy.
flagstone.60: I found one prisoner, Narael, alive deep beneath Flagstone. Narael was once a citizen of Nor City. He is too weak to walk by himself, but if I can find his wife in Nor City, I would be handsomely rewarded.
flagstone.70: I approached the sentry again and he was happy to hear the source of the undead is gone. I should talk to Yolgen, the priest of Stoutford, for a reward.
flagstone.100: Yolgen rewarded me handsomely for my efforts and is happy that there is one thing less the citizens of Stoutford have to worry about.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.

remgard.10: I have reached the bridge to enter the town of Remgard. According to the bridge guard, the town is closed for outsiders to enter, and no-one is currently allowed to leave. They are investigating some disappearances of some of the townspeople.
remgard.15: I have offered my assistance in helping the people of Remgard investigate what has happened to the townspeople that have disappeared.
remgard.20: The bridge guard has asked me to investigate an abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake. I should be wary of any inhabitants that may be there.
remgard.30: I have reported back to the bridge guard that I met Algangror in the abandoned house.
remgard.31: I have reported back to the bridge guard that the abandoned house was empty.
remgard.35: I have been granted entrance into Remgard. I should go visit Jhaeld, the town elder, to talk about what the next step should be. Jhaeld can probably be found in the tavern to the southeast.
remgard.40: Jhaeld was rather arrogant, but told me that they have had a problem with people disappearing for a while now. They have no clue what could be causing it.
remgard.50: I should visit four people in Remgard, and ask them about any clues on what might have happened to the missing people.
remgard.51: First is Norath, whose wife Bethir has disappeared. Norath can be found in the south-westernmost farmhouse.
remgard.52: Second, I should go talk to the Knights of Elythom, here in the tavern.
remgard.53: Third, I should go talk to the old woman Duaina in her house to the south.
remgard.54: Lastly, I should talk to Rothses, the armorer. He lives on the west side of town.
remgard.59: I tried to tell Jhaeld about Algangror, but he dismissed me as he had not heard me.
remgard.61: I have talked to Norath. He and his wife had been fighting recently, but he has no idea on what may have happened to her.
remgard.62: The Knights of Elythom in the Remgard tavern have had one of their knights disappearing recently. No one noticed anything when she disappeared, however.
remgard.63: Duaina has seen me in her visions. I did not understand all that she spoke of, but the parts that were clear were that me and Andor were parts of a larger plot. I wonder what this means? She did not speak of any disappearing people however, not that I could understand anyway.
remgard.64: Rothses told me that Bethir visited him the night before she disappeared, to sell some equipment. He did not see where she went after that.
remgard.70: I have talked to all of the people that Jhaeld wanted me to talk to, but did not get any information from any of them about what may have happened to the missing people. I should go back to Jhaeld and ask what his plans are next.
remgard.75: Jhaeld was really upset that I did not find out anything from the people that I was sent to talk to.
remgard.80: If I still want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should look for clues in other places.
remgard.110: Jhaeld does not want to talk to me. I will not help them find out what happened to the missing people of Remgard.

bjorgur_grave.10: Bjorgur in Prim at the base of the Blackwater mountain thinks that something has disturbed the grave of his parents, to the southwest of Prim, just outside the Elm mine.
bjorgur_grave.15: Bjorgur wants me to go check the grave, and make sure his family's dagger is still secure in the tomb.
bjorgur_grave.20: Fulus in Prim is interested in obtaining Bjorgur's family dagger that Bjorgur's grandfather used to possess.
bjorgur_grave.30: I met a man that wielded a strange looking dagger in the lower parts of a tomb to the southwest of Prim. He must have robbed this dagger from the grave.
bjorgur_grave.40: I placed the dagger back into its place in the tomb. The restless undead seem much less restless now, strangely enough.
bjorgur_grave.50: Bjorgur thanked me for my assistance. He told me I should also seek his relatives in Feygard.
bjorgur_grave.51: I have told Fulus that I helped Bjorgur return his family dagger to its original place.
bjorgur_grave.60: I have given Bjorgur's family dagger to Fulus. He thanked me for bringing it to him, and rewarded me handsomely.

benbyr.10: I have met Benbyr outside the Crossroads guardhouse. He wants to get revenge on an old 'business partner' of his - Tinlyn. Benbyr wants me to kill all Tinlyn's sheep.
benbyr.20: I have agreed to help Benbyr find Tinlyn's sheep and kill all eight of them. I should go look for them in the fields northwest of the Crossroads guardhouse.
benbyr.21: I have started attacking the sheep. I should return to Benbyr once I have killed all eight of them.
benbyr.30: Benbyr was thrilled to hear that all of Tinlyn's sheep are dead.
benbyr.60: I declined to help Benbyr kill the sheep.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
